ambiguity.detail: The exact background and financial standing of the bearded man remain mysterious.

verdict.hook_line: At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: The newlywed couple escapes to a humble, leaky forest cottage, finding surprising peace away from high society.
verdict.why_it_works: Provides a comforting emotional breather and character bonding moment after heavy dramatic conflict.
